clauses.sourceSentence: Applicants must be based in the United States.
clauses.selfScreenQuestion: Is your organization based in the United States?

clauses.sourceSentence: Applicants must work in youth learning, food security, or maternal health.
clauses.selfScreenQuestion: Does your proposed work address youth learning, food security, or maternal health?

clauses.sourceSentence: Applicants must be a 501(c)(3) public charity or a fiscally sponsored project.
clauses.selfScreenQuestion: Are you a 501(c)(3) public charity or a fiscally sponsored project?

clauses.sourceSentence: Applicants must have operated for at least two years.
clauses.selfScreenQuestion: Has your organization or project operated for at least two years?

uncompiledLanguage.sourceSentence: Priority will be given to community-rooted organizations with bold leadership.
uncompiledLanguage.reason: Community-rootedness and bold leadership require judgment and cannot be verified as literal eligibility facts.
uncompiledLanguage.suggestion: If local governance matters, name a factual test such as the required share of board members who live in the service area.
